title: Are the effects in the survivors-like arpg minigame in my autobattler game also too much?
author: Thicthor96
selftext: I am doing my best to capture as much feedback as possible. Ultimate goal is to publish this game & let reviews dictate future game direction. This is seedbound survivors, a minigame that unlocks once the player clears the hardest autobattler challenge in the base game. I clearly have some work to do on it & it feels like much is missing. I can only see so much as one guy! What sticks out to you? I've gotten consistent feedback on the autobattler side that the effects are too much. Are they still too much here?

comments.author: desederium
comments.body: I think it looks cool, but as long as it doesn’t interfere with gameplay, I enjoy those effects

comments.author: Xinnobun
comments.body: I wouldn't personally play it because theres honestly no skill involved with that range. Just looks like a ridiculously easy mode game.

replies.author: Thicthor96
replies.body: Fair enough! Although I’ll mention it’s much harder when you first unlock the mode, it is only easy now cuz I put hours into farming the best set in the game! This part of the survivors minigame you get to through a Poe style breach… it has a chance to spawn a portal to this zone. Choosing to go thru the portal in bad gear usually results in death 🤠
